observations.OpenSandbox: Slow capture persists intent before bounded background creation; terminal runtime observations drive convergence and CAS updates. Recovery may resubmit creation, so native replay authority must be considered separately.
observations.Temporal: Completed execution ID reuse has an explicit policy; RejectDuplicate returns the original already-started conflict even after execution is terminal.

applicability: GoldenHoop retains the original capture ID and separates observation from dispatch. A durable refusal blocks a late producer before the SQL source fence is released. Refusal source binding, inode-bound metadata and permanent history retention are GoldenHoop-specific requirements, not claimed upstream mechanisms.
validation: Real SQLite restart, filesystem, child SIGKILL and projection checks accompany this design. Actual KVM manager/worker refusal acceptance remains separate.
